description.narrative: The overarching goal of the Atlas Alliance’s project is to ensure the inclusion of, and active participation by, Disabled Persons’ Organisations (DPOs) in all relevant activities in the planning, implementation and follow up of the Global Disability Summit (GDS) 2022. Through the project, Atlas will ensure mobilization and advocacy for disability rights through DPOs and contribute in the communication to spread awareness about the Summit, provide strategic inputs on disability inclusion to the GDS governing structure as set out by the MFA, and ensure youth mobilization through a youth campaign and a youth summit.
